headline: Full time: FC Northbridge 1-1 Harbour City
body: A balanced draw ended 1-1 after goals from Strand 13' and Nakamura 46'. Possession was narrow in Harbour City's favour at 52% to FC Northbridge's 48%, and pass accuracy showed Harbour City more precise at 70% versus FC Northbridge 66%. Tactical analysis highlights a decisive moment at minute 9 when carrying the ball on would have raised the chance to score from 6.5% to 10.1%, and a clear positive decision at minute 41 where a pass produced a 7.3% chance compared with a 1.3% shot option.
bullets: Pass accuracy FC Northbridge 66%, Harbour City 70%
